as_told.title: Temple with cult symbology on St. James Island
as_told.place_text: Little St. James Island, US Virgin Islands

plain: The claim is that Jeffrey Epstein built a temple to Poseidon on Little St. James, his private island, and a labyrinth laid out like the ground plan of Atlantis at Zorro Ranch, his New Mexico property. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells it, relaying a YouTube host who goes by Dark Journalist. Jorjani says Poseidon was the "patron deity," and that Zorro Ranch is "where the breeding program was." He points to Plato's dialogues Timaeus and Critias, written in the fourth century BC, in Benjamin Jowett's translation. In those dialogues Poseidon receives "for his lot the island of Atlantis" and surrounds its center with "alternate zones of sea and land." That gives the ring-shaped layout a labyrinth could copy, though the dialogues of course say nothing about Epstein. Michels tells a thinner version on another episode: Epstein "built a temple with a cult symbology" on the island, with no mention of Poseidon or the ranch labyrinth. To the tellers, the buildings would show Epstein was acting out an ancient, secret worship.
